The number below these letters is the numerator to help identify a speciﬁc component on a project
within the control loop. When there are multiples of the same device used in a diagram, this number
helps viewers to reference that speciﬁc instrument.
If you were looking at a list of the controls, you could look at the control loop number to ﬁnd that
speciﬁc device on the P&ID. Companies have diﬀerent protocols for where these numbers originate.
